content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Variables with val and var** as part of **Kotlin Syntax and Basic Structure**. `val` prevents reassignment of the binding, while `var` allows reassignment; a `val` reference does not make the referenced object deeply immutable. Use the subtopics—Declaring Read-Only Variables with val, Declaring Mutable Variables with var, Reassignment and Immutability—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
